deadline.value: The priority deadline for Fall 2027 entry is December 1, 2026.
deadline.quote: The priority deadlines for application submission are December 1 for Fall semester

gre_general.value: Neither the GRE General nor the GRE Subject test is required.
gre_general.quote: Neither GRE General Test and GRE Subject Test are required.

gre_subject.value: The Chemistry GRE Subject test is not required.
gre_subject.quote: Neither GRE General Test and GRE Subject Test are required.

supervisor.value: Applicants do not need a faculty advisor before applying; labs are chosen after admission.
supervisor.quote: No, students do not secure a faculty member research advisor prior to submitting an application.

funding.value: Admitted PhD students get assistantships with a stipend, benefits and tuition remission, renewable for at least five years with satisfactory progress.
funding.quote: Applicants admitted to the PhD program are provided support in the form of teaching and/or research assistantships which provide a stipend, benefits, and tuition remission.

entry_route.value: Applicants with a bachelor's degree and no master's can apply directly to the PhD.
entry_route.quote: No, students with a bachelor’s degree (no master’s degree) are eligible to apply directly to the PhD program.

toefl_min.value: Chemistry requires an iBT score of 79 with a speaking score of 22, or IELTS 6.5 with speaking 6.5.
toefl_min.quote: TOEFL score (iBT) of at least 79 with a speaking score of at least 22

fee_waiver.value: Chemistry waives the fee only for applicants who hold, or will hold, a bachelor's or master's from a US institution.
fee_waiver.quote: We can provide an application fee waiver to any student who currently holds a bachelor’s or master’s degree from a US institution of higher education

notes: Department FAQ: fee waiver codes are requested by email before December 1.
